statusDefinitions.not-reassessed-in-this-phase: Not an implementation claim or a claim of missing API. See existing coverage and inspect before subsequent work.
statusDefinitions.implemented-client-local-fixture: New client behavior written against existing DTOs and tested locally; not proof of live server security.
statusDefinitions.partial-client-local-fixture: Only the explicitly stated portion of this inventory entry was delivered.
statusDefinitions.existing-client: Client source exists and was reviewed; use detailed note for partial behavior. Current full suite does not prove every server operation.
statusDefinitions.partial-client: Only stated portion exists; missing details remain visible.
statusDefinitions.frontend-remaining: Frontend work remains. Do not infer missing backend.
statusDefinitions.contract-or-policy-dependent: Contract not identified, insufficient, or product policy unresolved; existing service may be supplied.
statusDefinitions.development-sample: Explicit isolated sample, not live integration.
